caption: The drawing shows a wooden chest with a rectangular shape, depicted in a three-quarter view with its lid open to reveal internal compartments. The chest is supported by four turned legs and has one visible drawer at the bottom front, featuring two round knobs. The overall color scheme is a range of light to medium brown tones, indicating wood grain, with fine lines and shading used to illustrate depth and form. The main image is surrounded by four detail drawings, each enclosed in a square: the upper left shows a metal key and keyhole; the upper right shows a turned wooden knob in profile; the lower left shows a front elevation of the chest; and the lower right shows a side elevation of the chest. The background is off-white or beige, with all lines and details rendered in neutral and brown ink or watercolor wash.
title: Sugar Chest
